import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
/**
 * 一键学习功法指令处理器
 * 指令格式: /一键学习功法
 *          /一键学习功法 确认
 *          /取消一键学习功法
 * 自动学习储物袋中所有未锁定、未学习的功法
 * 跳过：已有同技能的已学/使用中功法（避免需要确认替换的冲突）
 */
import { CONFIRM_KEYWORD, EMPTY_STRING, FIRST_ARG_INDEX } from '@src/constants';
import { createBackendRequestContext } from '@src/api/bot/context';
import App from '@src/response-apps/skillBook/batchLearn/app';
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import { FormatGui } from '@src/utils/messageHelper';
import { Format, onResponse } from 'alemonjs';

const response = onResponse(selects, async e => {
  const [message] = useMessage();
  const bid = e?.UserId;
  const isPrivate = e.isPrivate ?? false;

  const uid = e.uid as number;
  const rawText = (e.MessageText || EMPTY_STRING).trim();
  const isCancel = /^(!|！|\/|#|＃)?取消一键学习功法$/.test(rawText);

  if (isCancel) {
    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    md.addText('已取消一键学习功法');
    md.addNewline();
    md.addNewline();
    md.addText('💡如需继续，请重新发送 /一键学习功法');

    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '一键学习功法', content: md, footer: [{ label: '我的储物袋', command: '/我的储物袋 功法' }] }));

    return;
  }

  const messageText = rawText.replace(/^(!|！|\/|#|＃)?一键学习功法\s*/, EMPTY_STRING).trim();
  const args = messageText ? messageText.split(/\s+/) : [];
  const isConfirm = args[FIRST_ARG_INDEX] === CONFIRM_KEYWORD;

  // 调用数据层
  const result = await App({ bid, uid, previewOnly: !isConfirm, request: isConfirm ? createBackendRequestContext(e) : undefined });

  switch (result.code) {
    case 'NOT_REGISTERED': {
      const md = Format.createMarkdown();

      md.addText(result.data.message);

      void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));

      return;
    }

    case 'PREVIEW': {
      const { learnList, skippedConflicts } = result.data;
      const md = Format.createMarkdown();

      md.addBold('⚠️ 一键学习确认');
      md.addNewline();
      md.addNewline();
      md.addText(`预计学习 ${learnList.length} 本功法：`);
      md.addNewline();

      for (const item of learnList) {
        md.addText(`• 【${item.name}】${item.skillType}`);
        md.addNewline();
      }

      if (skippedConflicts.length > 0) {
        md.addNewline();
        md.addText(`⏭ 将跳过 ${skippedConflicts.length} 本同技能功法`);
        md.addNewline();
      }

      md.addNewline();
      md.addText('确认后将直接学习，取消则不执行。');

      void message.send(
        FormatGui({
          isPrivate,
          bid,
          title: '一键学习功法',
          content: md,
          footer: [
            { label: '确认学习', command: '/一键学习功法 确认' },
            { label: '取消', command: '/取消一键学习功法' }
          ]
        })
      );

      return;
    }

    case 'NO_AVAILABLE': {
      const md = Format.createMarkdown();

      md.addText(result.data.message);
      md.addNewline();
      md.addNewline();
      md.addText('💡 可学习的功法需满足：未锁定、未学习');

      md.addNewline();

      void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md, footer: [{ label: '我的储物袋', command: '/我的储物袋 功法' }] }));

      return;
    }

    case 'LOAD_FAILED': {
      const md = Format.createMarkdown();

      md.addText(result.data.message);

      void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));

      return;
    }

    case 'OK': {
      const { successList, failList, skippedConflicts } = result.data;

      // 构建结果消息
      const md = Format.createMarkdown();

      if (successList.length > 0) {
        md.addBold(`✅ 成功学习 ${successList.length} 本功法`);
        md.addNewline();

        for (const item of successList) {
          md.addText(`• 【${item.name}】${item.skillType}`);
          md.addNewline();
        }
      } else {
        md.addBold('没有新功法可学习');
        md.addNewline();
      }

      if (skippedConflicts.length > 0) {
        md.addNewline();
        md.addText(`⏭ 跳过 ${skippedConflicts.length} 本（已有同技能功法）：`);
        md.addNewline();

        // 合并同名同类型的跳过项，显示为 ×N
        const skippedMap = new Map<string, number>();
        const skippedOrder: string[] = [];

        for (const item of skippedConflicts) {
          const key = `${item.name}|${item.skillType}`;
          const prev = skippedMap.get(key) ?? 0;

          if (prev === 0) {
            skippedOrder.push(key);
          }
          skippedMap.set(key, prev + 1);
        }

        for (const key of skippedOrder) {
          const [name, skillType] = key.split('|');
          const count = skippedMap.get(key)!;

          md.addText(`• 【${name}】${skillType}${count > 1 ? ` ×${count}` : ''}`);
          md.addNewline();
        }
      }

      if (failList.length > 0) {
        md.addNewline();
        md.addText(`❌ 失败 ${failList.length} 本：`);
        md.addNewline();

        for (const item of failList) {
          md.addText(`• 【${item.name}】${item.reason}`);
          md.addNewline();
        }
      }

      md.addNewline();

      void message.send(
        FormatGui({
          isPrivate,
          bid,
          title: '一键学习功法',
          content: md,
          footer: [
            { label: '查看我的功法', command: '/我的功法' },
            { label: '储物袋', command: '/我的储物袋 功法' }
          ]
        })
      );
    }
  }
});

export default response;
